title: From chimaek to scandal: Jensen Huang's star loses luster in Korea
caption:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who once enjoyed celebrity status in South Korea, is facing major fallout following revelations of infidelity. His board is now considering his future as investors worry about the company's stability.
